cond_0001.intro:
We are looking for a motivated early-career intelligence analyst to join us in an embedded role within a globally dispersed intelligence team. Using the latest industry technologies and practices, Intelligence Analysts identify, analyze, and advise on threats and risks that could affect the client's people, operations, and data.
This position would suit anyone with a strong interest in global security affairs who wants to continue building their career in threat monitoring and analysis. Although we are ideally looking for someone with experience in intelligence or risk management, we also welcome applications from anyone with related experience and skills (e.g. Research, think tanks or journalism) with a demonstrated interest in global affairs and technology.
Applicants for this role require the ability to research and analyze a wide range of information to create insightful analysis in accordance with strict deadlines, including presenting and incorporating relevant data and visualizations. Due to being embedded, the candidate will engage directly with clients to provide immediate support and consulting. This requires emotional intelligence, creative thinking, maturity and judgement in order to successfully interpret client requests and provide insightful information.
The Security Analyst will be managed by the embedded team leader on a day-to-day basis, but will also report to [Company name masked]'s Embed Operations team in [Location masked]. Full support and guidance will be provided from our head office; including training, professional development, and access to our global network of [Company name masked] analysts.
This position represents an excellent opportunity for the right candidate to continue their development as an intelligence analyst with a leading firm. We offer strong career progression and are invested in building individuals' professional profiles. Moreover, being embedded truly offers ""the best of both worlds"", giving a small firm ethos alongside large firm exposure and experience.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Use all-source intelligence (including alert feeds, traditional and social media, and in-house sources) to monitor for security incidents and trends within the client's areas of operation and locations and determine the likely impact to staff, assets, operations, events and reputation.
Escalate security incidents to client stakeholders, following efficient and rehearsed procedures.
Maintain visibility on employee movements and their proximity to notable incidents and events, advising accordingly through required reporting methods.
Produce intelligence products on a range of physical and cyber threats and risks.
Monitor and respond to threat actors and persons of interest (POIs), developing an assessment of their intent, capability and tactics.
Support internal stakeholders with ad hoc reporting on geopolitical developments, scenario planning, forecasts and other related topics.
Display creative thinking and consulting skills to deliver a continually improving service for the client.
Be an effective member of a small team, focused on delivery of lean, high-impact services.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in International Relations, Security Studies, Journalism, or related field
An excellent academic record and professional experience in a relevant field, ideally with 1-3 years of experience in threat monitoring and analysis research, public sector or a related area
Ability to interpret, organize and visualize data
Ability to determine how geopolitical and security threats could impact private sector personnel, data and operations
Excellent research skills, with the ability to rapidly digest, evaluate and ""sift"" large quantities of information from a range of sources
Analytical flair, with the ability to provide rigorous, creative insight into complex situations
Ability to multi-task in a fast-paced working environment
Ability to work in both individual and team environments
Excellent attention to detail
High level competency with MS Office tools
Full authorisation to live and work in [Location masked]
Preferred Requirements
Advanced degree (Master's or above)
Strong professional network
Experience working in intelligence, geopolitical or security-related disciplines
Strong personal initiative, with the ability to take ownership of tasks and deliver solutions under minimal guidance
Experience with analytical software or OSINT tools
Additional languages

Although we are ideally looking for someone with experience in intelligence or risk management, we also welcome applications from anyone with related experience and skills (e.g. Research, think tanks or journalism) with a demonstrated interest in global affairs and technology.

We are looking for a motivated early-career intelligence analyst to join [Company name masked] in an embedded role within a globally dispersed intelligence team. Using the latest industry technologies and practices, analysts work together to identify, analyze, and advise on threats and risks that could affect the client's people, operations, and data.
This position would suit anyone with a strong interest in global security affairs who wants to continue building their career in threat monitoring and analysis. Although we are ideally looking for someone with experience in intelligence or risk management, we also welcome applications from anyone with related experience and skills (e.g. Research, think tanks or journalism) with a demonstrated interest in global affairs and technology.
Applicants for this role need to research and analyze a wide range of information to produce insightful analysis within strict deadlines, including incorporating relevant data and visualizations. As an embedded analyst, you will work directly with clients to provide support and consulting, which requires emotional intelligence, creative thinking, maturity, and judgement to interpret client requests and deliver useful information.
The Security Analyst will coordinate with the embedded team leader on a day-to-day basis, and will also work alongside [Company name masked]'s Embed Operations team. Full support and guidance will be provided from our head office, including training, professional development, and access to our global network of analysts.
cond_0090.responsibilities:
Work with the team to use all-source intelligence (including alert feeds, traditional and social media, and in-house sources) to monitor for security incidents and trends within the client's areas of operation and locations, and help assess the likely impact to staff, assets, operations, events and reputation.
Coordinate with client stakeholders to escalate security incidents, following efficient and rehearsed procedures.
Help maintain visibility on employee movements and their proximity to notable incidents and events, sharing findings through required reporting methods.
Collaborate on the production of intelligence products covering a range of physical and cyber threats and risks.
Work alongside the team to monitor and respond to threat actors and persons of interest (POIs), contributing to shared assessments of their intent, capability and tactics.
Support internal stakeholders with ad hoc reporting on geopolitical developments, scenario planning, forecasts and other related topics.
Contribute creative thinking and consulting skills to help deliver a continually improving service for the client.
Be an effective member of a small team, focused on delivery of lean, high-impact services.

[Company name masked] is looking for a motivated early-career intelligence analyst to join us in an embedded role within a globally dispersed intelligence team. Using the latest industry technologies and practices, Intelligence Analysts identify, analyze, and advise on threats and risks that could affect the client's people, operations, and data.
This position would suit anyone with a strong interest in global security affairs who wants to continue building their career in threat monitoring and analysis. Although we are ideally looking for someone with experience in intelligence or risk management, we also welcome applications from anyone with related experience and skills (e.g. Research, think tanks or journalism) with a demonstrated interest in global affairs and technology.
Applicants for this role require the ability to research and analyze a wide range of information to create insightful analysis in accordance with strict deadlines, including presenting and incorporating relevant data and visualizations. Due to being embedded, the candidate will engage directly with clients to provide immediate support and consulting. This requires emotional intelligence, creative thinking, maturity and judgement in order to successfully interpret client requests and provide insightful information.
The Security Analyst will be managed by the embedded team leader on a day-to-day basis, but will also report to [Company name masked]'s Embed Operations team in [Location masked]. Full support and guidance will be provided from our head office; including training, professional development, and access to our global network of [Company name masked] analysts.
This position represents an excellent opportunity for the right candidate to continue their development as an intelligence analyst with a leading firm. We offer strong career progression and are invested in building individuals' professional profiles. Moreover, being embedded truly offers ""the best of both worlds"", giving a small firm ethos alongside large firm exposure and experience.
cond_0200.responsibilities:
Use all-source intelligence (including alert feeds, traditional and social media, and in-house sources) to monitor for security incidents and trends within the client's areas of operation and locations and determine the likely impact to staff, assets, operations, events and reputation.
Escalate security incidents to client stakeholders, following efficient and rehearsed procedures.
Maintain visibility on employee movements and their proximity to notable incidents and events, advising accordingly through required reporting methods.
Produce intelligence products on a range of physical and cyber threats and risks.
Monitor and respond to threat actors and persons of interest (POIs), developing an assessment of their intent, capability and tactics.
Support internal stakeholders with ad hoc reporting on geopolitical developments, scenario planning, forecasts and other related topics.
Display creative thinking and consulting skills to deliver a continually improving service for the client.
Be an effective member of a small team, focused on delivery of lean, high-impact services.
cond_0200.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in International Relations, Security Studies, Journalism, or related field; advanced degree strongly preferred
Proven track record in threat monitoring and analysis, research, public sector, or a related area, with a minimum of 3 years of demonstrated expertise in a relevant field
Deep knowledge of how geopolitical and security threats could impact private sector personnel, data and operations
Exceptional research skills, with the ability to rapidly digest, evaluate and sift large quantities of information from a range of sources
Strong command of data interpretation, organization and visualization
Analytical flair, with the ability to provide rigorous, creative insight into complex situations
Exceptional attention to detail
Strong command of MS Office tools
Full authorisation to live and work in [Location masked]
Preferred Requirements
Advanced degree (Master's or above)
Demonstrated expertise in intelligence, geopolitical or security-related disciplines
Proficiency in analytical software or OSINT tools
Strong professional network
Exceptional personal initiative, with the ability to take ownership of tasks and deliver solutions under minimal guidance
Ability to work effectively in both individual and team environments
Additional languages
We welcome applications from candidates who meet the core criteria, even if they do not meet every preferred requirement.
cond_0200.values: We value work that supports people well and reflects genuine care in how it is done. We believe responsibility and respect matter as much as the end result.

cond_0232.intro:

[Company name masked] is looking for an early-career intelligence analyst to fill an embedded role within a globally dispersed intelligence team. Using current industry technologies and practices, analysts identify, analyze, and advise on threats and risks that could affect the client's people, operations, and data.
This position would suit someone with a strong interest in global security affairs who wants to build their career in threat monitoring and analysis. We are ideally looking for someone with experience in intelligence or risk management, but also welcome applications from candidates with related experience and skills (e.g. Research, think tanks, or journalism) and a demonstrated interest in global affairs and technology.

cond_0283.intro:

Using the latest industry technologies and practices, Intelligence Analysts identify, analyze, and advise on threats and risks that could affect the client's people, operations, and data.
This position would suit anyone with a strong interest in global security affairs who wants to continue building their career in threat monitoring and analysis. Although we are ideally looking for someone with experience in intelligence or risk management, we also welcome applications from anyone with related experience and skills (e.g. Research, think tanks or journalism) with a demonstrated interest in global affairs and technology.

cond_0307.intro:
We are looking for a motivated early-career intelligence analyst to join us in an embedded role within a globally dispersed intelligence team. Using the latest industry technologies and practices, Intelligence Analysts identify, analyze, and advise on threats and risks that could affect the client's people, operations, and data.
This position would suit anyone with a strong interest in global security affairs who wants to continue building their career in threat monitoring and analysis. Although we are ideally looking for someone with experience in intelligence or risk management, we also welcome applications from anyone with related experience and skills (e.g. Research, think tanks or journalism) with a demonstrated interest in global affairs and technology.
Applicants for this role require the ability to research and analyze a wide range of information to create insightful analysis in accordance with strict deadlines, including presenting and incorporating relevant data and visualizations. Due to being embedded, the candidate will engage directly with clients to provide immediate support and consulting. This requires emotional intelligence, creative thinking, maturity and judgement in order to successfully interpret client requests and provide insightful information.
The Security Analyst will be managed by the embedded team leader on a day-to-day basis, but will also report to [Company name masked]'s Embed Operations team in [Location masked]. Full support and guidance will be provided from our head office; including training, professional development, and access to our global network of [Company name masked] analysts.
This position represents an excellent opportunity for the right candidate to continue their development as an intelligence analyst with a leading firm. We offer strong career progression and are invested in building individuals' professional profiles. Moreover, being embedded truly offers ""the best of both worlds"", giving a small firm ethos alongside large firm exposure and experience.
cond_0307.responsibilities:
Use all-source intelligence (including alert feeds, traditional and social media, and in-house sources) to monitor for security incidents and trends within the client's areas of operation and locations and determine the likely impact to staff, assets, operations, events and reputation.
Escalate security incidents to client stakeholders, following efficient and rehearsed procedures.
Maintain visibility on employee movements and their proximity to notable incidents and events, advising accordingly through required reporting methods.
Produce intelligence products on a range of physical and cyber threats and risks.
Monitor and respond to threat actors and persons of interest (POIs), developing an assessment of their intent, capability and tactics.
Support internal stakeholders with ad hoc reporting on geopolitical developments, scenario planning, forecasts and other related topics.
Display creative thinking and consulting skills to deliver a continually improving service for the client.
Be an effective member of a small team, focused on delivery of lean, high-impact services.
cond_0307.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in International Relations, Security Studies, Journalism, or related field
An excellent academic record and professional experience in a relevant field, ideally with 1-3 years of experience in threat monitoring and analysis research, public sector or a related area
Ability to interpret, organize and visualize data
Ability to determine how geopolitical and security threats could impact private sector personnel, data and operations
Excellent research skills, with the ability to rapidly digest, evaluate and ""sift"" large quantities of information from a range of sources
Analytical flair, with the ability to provide rigorous, creative insight into complex situations
Ability to multi-task in a fast-paced working environment
Ability to work in both individual and team environments
Excellent attention to detail
High level competency with MS Office tools
Full authorisation to live and work in [Location masked]
Preferred Requirements
Advanced degree (Master's or above)
Strong professional network
Experience working in intelligence, geopolitical or security-related disciplines
Strong personal initiative, with the ability to take ownership of tasks and deliver solutions under minimal guidance
Experience with analytical software or OSINT tools
Additional languages
cond_0307.values: We value achievement and a strong commitment to quality in what we deliver. We aim to set high standards and meet them consistently.

[Company name masked] is looking for a motivated early-career intelligence analyst to join us in an embedded role within a globally dispersed intelligence team. Using the latest industry technologies and practices, Intelligence Analysts identify, analyze, and advise on threats and risks that could affect the client's people, operations, and data.
This position would suit anyone with a strong interest in global security affairs who wants to continue building their career in threat monitoring and analysis. Although we are ideally looking for someone with experience in intelligence or risk management, we also welcome applications from anyone with related experience and skills (e.g. Research, think tanks or journalism) with a demonstrated interest in global affairs and technology.
Applicants for this role require the ability to research and analyze a wide range of information to create insightful analysis in accordance with strict deadlines, including presenting and incorporating relevant data and visualizations. Due to being embedded, the candidate will engage directly with clients to provide immediate support and consulting. This requires emotional intelligence, creative thinking, maturity and judgement in order to successfully interpret client requests and provide insightful information.
The Security Analyst will be managed by the embedded team leader on a day-to-day basis, but will also report to [Company name masked]'s Embed Operations team in [Location masked]. Full support and guidance will be provided from our head office; including training, professional development, and access to our global network of [Company name masked] analysts.
This position represents an excellent opportunity for the right candidate to continue their development as an intelligence analyst with a leading firm. We offer strong career progression and are invested in building individuals' professional profiles. Moreover, being embedded truly offers ""the best of both worlds"", giving a small firm ethos alongside large firm exposure and experience.
cond_0362.responsibilities:
Use all-source intelligence (including alert feeds, traditional and social media, and in-house sources) to monitor for security incidents and trends within the client's areas of operation and locations and determine the likely impact to staff, assets, operations, events and reputation.
Escalate security incidents to client stakeholders, following efficient and rehearsed procedures.
Maintain visibility on employee movements and their proximity to notable incidents and events, advising accordingly through required reporting methods.
Produce intelligence products on a range of physical and cyber threats and risks.
Monitor and respond to threat actors and persons of interest (POIs), developing an assessment of their intent, capability and tactics.
Support internal stakeholders with ad hoc reporting on geopolitical developments, scenario planning, forecasts and other related topics.
Display creative thinking and consulting skills to deliver a continually improving service for the client.
Be an effective member of a small team, focused on delivery of lean, high-impact services.
cond_0362.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in International Relations, Security Studies, Journalism, or related field; advanced degree strongly preferred
Proven track record in threat monitoring and analysis, research, public sector, or a related area, with a minimum of 3 years of demonstrated expertise in a relevant field
Deep knowledge of how geopolitical and security threats could impact private sector personnel, data and operations
Exceptional research skills, with the ability to rapidly digest, evaluate and sift large quantities of information from a range of sources
Strong command of data interpretation, organization and visualization
Analytical flair, with the ability to provide rigorous, creative insight into complex situations
Exceptional attention to detail
Strong command of MS Office tools
Full authorisation to live and work in [Location masked]
Preferred Requirements
Advanced degree (Master's or above)
Demonstrated expertise in intelligence, geopolitical or security-related disciplines
Proficiency in analytical software or OSINT tools
Strong professional network
Exceptional personal initiative, with the ability to take ownership of tasks and deliver solutions under minimal guidance
Ability to work effectively in both individual and team environments
Additional languages
We welcome applications from candidates who meet the core criteria, even if they do not meet every preferred requirement.
